description: Caption Writer — Type a topic, get a batch of TikTok and Instagram captions back — each with a hook that stops the scroll. Runs claude-haiku-4.5 — the response names the model that served the call. Input: {topic: string, platform?: 'tiktok'|'instagram'|'both', tone?: string, count?: number}. Returns {captions: [{text, hook}], platform, model}. $1 a batch (120 MESH). (120 MESH/call, a tool · content)

count.description: how many captions in the batch — defaults to 5, max 10

platform.description: where the captions will run — defaults to both

tone.description: how they should sound — defaults to natural

topic.description: REQUIRED — what the captions are about

name: caption-writer
title: Caption Writer
